conviction_note: Everything this release can carry was pre-released: H1 figures to the million yen on 2026-10-16 (速報値, record H1, ordinary +42.4%), the 65-yen interim dividend on 2026-09-18, and the company publishes no full-year forecast, so there is no revision to make; the window (sealed 10:05 JST spot to the 2026-10-26 close) is market beta on a high-beta retail broker, so p_up 50 and the scaled number is 0; the findings sum to -0.1, a near-zero that agrees with it.
bar: The company's own preliminary H1 figures released 2026-10-16 16:30 JST (operating revenue 18,141m, OP 7,906m, ordinary 8,237m, NP 6,320m, EPS 269.09): https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20261016/140120261015551021.pdf . No full-year 会社予想 exists (業績予想は開示しておりません) and no IFIS/四季報 consensus was found; the 短信 is expected to land on the 速報値, hence 0.0.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position >=0.5%), change 0.0 pts as of 2026-10-22 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, per baseline). 信用倍率 7.84 (baseline, scraped): a crowded margin long. Tape: -14.3% over 20 sessions and -10.1% from the 10/16 prelim close (4,415) to today's 09:57 print (3,970) against about -4.8% for the Nikkei and -4.9% for Nomura (8604) and -4.4% for Daiwa (8601) over the same days (Yahoo chart API). No option market, no skew. A crowded margin long in a stock underperforming peers can keep supplying sellers; the underperformance after a record pre-release can equally relieve. Not filed as a finding; it is the run-up control and the lean, already in the baseline.

findings.finding: H1 was pre-released to the million yen on 2026-10-16 (record H1; ordinary 8,237m, +42.4% y/y); the Jul-Sep quarter it implies (ordinary 3,550m = 8,237 - Q1 4,687) is +15% y/y but -24% q/q, and that deceleration is arithmetic on two public documents, so the 10/23 短信 adds detail (commission mix, US-equity revenue split) but no new headline number.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name always pre-releases (速報値 a week before the 短信). Next-session moves after the confirming 短信: 2025-07-25 +0.41%, 2025-10-24 (15:00) day -0.82% then +2.98%, 2026-01-30 -2.01%, 2026-04-24 -1.60%, 2026-07-24 +1.05% (Yahoo chart API, 8707.T); no consistent sign, scale ~1-2%, mostly market.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the preliminary was published at 16:30 on 10/16 and the stock has since fallen ~10% against ~5% for the Nikkei and the large brokers, so the q/q deceleration has had a week of trading. Filed at 0 because it is the print's content; if it were NOT priced the stock would not have underperformed its peers after a record-H1 headline.
findings.independence: Q1 standalone figures from kabutan's quarterly table (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=8707, 26.04-06 ordinary 4,687m) and kabutan's 10/16 article (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8707&b=k202610160014); same underlying company documents.

findings.finding: The 65-yen interim dividend (DOE ~2% formula, +5 yen y/y) was pre-announced on 2026-09-18 and the 50%+ total-return target is met by a year-end top-up (FY3/26 year-end 165 yen announced 2026-03-19), with no 自社株買い in any disclosure since mid-2025, so a capital-return surprise at this print is unlikely: 65 yen is 24% of H1 EPS 269.09.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Dividend announcements come separately, before the print: 2025-08-22 interim set (+0.73% day, +1.88% next), 2026-03-19 year-end 165 yen (-2.71% day, +0.97% next 'reported as 反発'), 2026-09-18 interim 65 yen (-0.11%, -1.79%). At the 2025-10-24 H1 短信 the only return item was the formal resolution of the already-announced interim dividend.
findings.why_not_priced: Priced: the stock went ex-dividend on 2026-09-29 (4,755 -> 4,620). The only unpriced piece would be a buyback, and the company's disclosure list back to mid-2025 shows none, with returns routed through the year-end dividend; a market expecting one would not have let the stock fall 10% into the 短信.
findings.independence: TDnet original of the 9/18 notice: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260918/140120260917537647.pdf (same document); 2025-10-24 剰余金の配当（中間配当） listing on https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8707&page=6 (different date, same company).

findings.finding: On 2026-10-16 the broker disclosed that unauthorised access to its online-trading system vendor トレードワークス leaked names and e-mail addresses of 4,611 internet customers (detected 10/14; no account-access risk, no secondary damage), with costs reported to be borne by the vendor; the 短信 may carry it as a note but not as a cost.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior incident at this name. Reaction to the 10/16 combined release (prelim + leak): +0.57% next session (4,390 -> 4,415).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: public a week ago on TDnet. Filed small because the stock's underperformance since may partly reflect it, and a 短信 note on remediation is a minor possible headline; a cost provision would show up as an extraordinary loss, which the vendor-pays report argues against.
findings.independence: Press summary saying TW bears the costs and that 内藤証券 and むさし証券 had related incidents: https://rocket-boys.co.jp/?p=43986 (snippet_only, not fetched).

outside_window.finding: The year-end dividend top-up to meet the 50%+ total-return policy: on H1 EPS 269.09 against a 65-yen interim, a full year near last year's 444.61 EPS would imply a large year-end dividend, decided around March 2027 as it was on 2026-03-19.
